chunks: From him, from al-Riyān, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Hārūn ibn Muslim, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) regarding:
A man who had intercourse with a woman, he said: When the circumcised parts meet, the dowry becomes obligatory and the waiting period [begins].

key_terms.الْخِتَانَانِ: The circumcised parts (penis and vulva), indicating sexual penetration
key_terms.الْعِدَّةُ: The waiting period a woman must observe after divorce or death of husband
key_terms.الْمَهْرُ: The dowry or bridal gift given to the wife

ai.seo_question: When does the dowry become obligatory in Shia Islamic jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the precise moment of consummation (tamaam al-wad') required to trigger the full dowry (mahr al-mithl) and the start of the iddah, a key criterion in Shia fiqh for distinguishing between partial and full marital rights. It underscores the legal significance of physical union in establishing the wife's financial and temporal status within the marriage contract.
